firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently had an adventure starts.
clarifications: Starting coins and guild bonuses are distributed clockwise from that player.
The same player then takes the first turn, and play proceeds clockwise.
internalEvidence: The Mirror Box Games rulebook names the most recent adventurer in setup step 12 and confirms that player takes the first regular turn after clockwise starting distributions.
